elements_selected.content: Add a Reason subcommand group to src/cli.rs with sub-subcommands: Status, Explain, WhatIf, WhyNot, Require, Conflicts, Export, Provenance. Initially implement only Status. In src/main.rs, wire up cmd_reason_status: scan vault, extract SPL, build theory, compute conclusions, format output. CLI options per CON-012: --positive, --negative, --definite, --defeasible, --literal <PAT>. JSON output includes theory summary (facts/rules/defeaters/superiority/source_files), conclusions array with provenance, summary counts, and diagnostics. Table output shows conclusions in a human-readable table. Exit codes: 0 success, 1 no SPL blocks, 2 parse errors.
